latestTerminalSummary:
PASS: the reusable recipe component passed the finite check, with one minor defect found.

Used one native Goal (`goal-01a122a6…`, completed) referring to the assignment; all checks ran on owned scratch copies, no workers, no `delegate_task`, no polling, no Git or config changes. Verified: stage preparation and all 7 config guards reject correctly, no plan bytes in the initial investigator packet, reveal gates + one-use SHA-256 receipt correct, predecessor/tamper gates block correctly, retry/idempotency guards hold, and all five `bootstrap.js` → `prepare.py` invocations match the argparse contract. No downloaded software (two grep hits were false positives: a "do not run downloaded code" prohibition and `exec_command` matching `.exe`).

Defect: [patch-bootstrap-text.diff](/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/helpers/recipe-qualification/patch-bootstrap-text.diff) — `bootstrap.js:61` calls `text({...})` with an object while lines 42/52/68 pass `JSON.stringify(...)`; the memory-gate message may render wrong. One-line fix saved as the optional patch.

Saved before Goal completion in `helpers/recipe-qualification/`: [result.md](/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/helpers/recipe-qualification/result.md) (exact commands + outcomes), [result.json](/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/helpers/recipe-qualification/result.json), and the patch. Owned scratch and `/tmp` runtime deleted; reusable originals untouched (hashes re-verified). A passing component does not prove research quality or a production improvement.
